stem:
The dot plots show the numbers of apples picked by members of two different tour groups at an orchard.

Tour Group 1                                                Tour Group 2

[Dot plots showing the number of apples picked from 1 to 10]

Which statement correctly compares these two data sets?

options.label: F
options.text: The median of the data is the same for both data sets.

options.label: G
options.text: The mode of the data is the same for both data sets.

options.label: H
options.text: The range of the data is the same for both data sets.

options.label: J
options.text: The distribution of the data is symmetrical for both data sets.
